data.narrative:
Sunday Robotics is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Tony Zhao and Cheng Chi that has raised $200M to date. The comparable universe in Robotics & Manufacturing consists of 9 private peers (including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI) and 1 public company (277810.KQ), though peer-group density at the Seed stage remains limited.

The Stage-Progression method is the applicable triangulation approach given data constraints. Using the $200M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a standard 2.5x multiplier for Seed-to-next-stage progression yields $500M. The Peer-Median method is not applicable; while 10 same-sector peers exist, only 1 operates at the same stage and insufficient comparable transactions cluster at adjacent stages or similar valuation tiers to support reliable median estimation. Cross-sectional peer analysis would introduce substantial selection bias.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $425M (low) to $575M (high), with a median of $500M. This range reflects conservative assumptions around the stage-progression multiple applied to disclosed capital raised. Key uncertainties include: the composition and profitability trajectory of the $200M raised (seed vs. extended rounds), actual burn and runway relative to stage benchmarks, and product-market fit indicators beyond capital raised. Additional revenue, unit economics, or customer concentration data would materially refine this estimate.
